source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 截图颜色连通区域提取的近似点；遮挡点不可恢复；椭圆由截图估读
provenance.en: Approximate coordinates extracted from colored connected components. Overlapping points are lost; ellipses were visually estimated.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每个样本的丰度/特征矩阵或样本间距离矩阵，以及样本 ID 到组别的映射。
距离度量、变换方法、PCoA 实现、PCoA1/2 坐标和各轴解释比例。
PERMANOVA 的模型、置换次数、分层信息，以及椭圆计算约定。
en: A sample-feature/abundance matrix or sample distance matrix, plus sample-to-group metadata.
Distance metric, transformations, PCoA method, axis 1/2 coordinates and explained variation.
PERMANOVA model, permutation count and strata, plus the ellipse convention.

preprocessing.zh: 先在原分析流程中计算 PCoA，再把前两轴坐标写入 x/y。本项目不运行 PCoA 或 PERMANOVA；新数据的椭圆使用二维协方差近似。
preprocessing.en: Compute PCoA upstream and export the first two coordinates to x/y. This project does not run PCoA or PERMANOVA; replacement-data ellipses use a bivariate covariance approximation.

description.zh: 实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.zh: 已转换的横轴坐标；不是原始特征矩阵
description.en: Transformed x coordinate, not a raw feature matrix
